editorial:
Imagine you have your whole life figured out. You have a great partner and a happy home in Stockholm. That is exactly where you find Christoffer at the start of this story. Everything feels light and easy until his father passes away. Suddenly, his mother puts a huge amount of pressure on him to move back home and save the family business from going broke. You will feel his struggle as he tries to balance what he wants for himself against the heavy weight of family loyalty and the ghosts of his past.

The acting here is top notch and makes the sadness feel very real. You will see Christoffer slowly lose his spark as the job eats away at his marriage and his happiness. While the movie moves a bit slow at times, the emotional payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about family secrets and difficult choices, you should definitely give this a go. It is a great pick for a quiet night in when you want a story that actually makes you think.
endingExplained: The movie ends with Christoffer realizing that trying to save the company has cost him everything. He has lost his relationship with Maria and his own sense of peace. He eventually accepts that he cannot fix the past or the business by sacrificing his soul. He walks away from the burden of the family legacy to find himself again, finally breaking the cycle of pressure and expectation from his mother.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about family struggles and personal growth.
